sources.title: Mission, Vision & Values | Indiana Wesleyan University
sources.quote: Indiana Wesleyan University is an institution of The Wesleyan Church, a Protestant Christian denomination rooted in the teachings of John Wesley. This affiliation provides theological grounding, accountability, and shared values that shape the university's mission and identity.
